items.title: De documentaire over NEC-matchwinner Emre Mor komt nog
items.summary: Emre Mor kon dinsdagavond nog niet helemaal bevatten wat er was gebeurd. NEC zorgde voor een stunt van jewelste door Olympiakos Piraeus te verslaan in de derde voorronde van de Champions League, met dank aan de winnende treffer van het voormalige toptalent. De Turkse Deen vertelt over het oorbelincident bij zijn invalbeurt en waarom zijn doelpunt voor hem veel meer betekende.

items.title: Uitschakeling komt hard aan bij Olympiakos: 'Maar NEC was gewoon beter'
items.summary: De uitschakeling in de derde voorronde van de Champions League tegen NEC komt hard aan bij Olympiakos Piraeus. Plaatsing voor de leaguefase van het miljardenbal was topprioriteit voor de Griekse topclub, maar de Nijmegenaren stuntten dinsdagavond door na verlenging met 2-1 te winnen . Trainer José Luis Mendilibar was na afloop realistisch.

items.title: Hamer komend seizoen bij Coventry in de Premier League te bewonderen

items.title: 'Oudjes' Linssen (35) en Tadic (37) zorgen voor fraaie mijlpaal deze eeuw

items.title: Emery positive about Aston Villa’s outlook despite summer exits as PSG await
items.summary: Ebullient manager takes his side to Salzburg to cross swords with the European champions in the Super Cup One thing was almost instantly detectable as Unai Emery walked into a stuffy room inside the Red Bull Arena on the eve of Wednesday’s Super Cup against Paris Saint-Germain. After a summer of change, Aston Villa’s manager appeared uber-relaxed, confident his team will absorb a series of headline departures. He cracked a joke about his English improving and poked fun at John McGinn, impersonating his captain while next to him on the auditorium’s top table. Emery was in a jovial mood, then. But he was also switched on, alert to the frequency, the tone of the wave of questions at the beginning of his fourth full season in the job. “You ask about the changes of coaches and players, but McGinn is intelligent and his answer was fantastic,” Emery said with a smile. “When he arrived here [in 2018] they were in the Championship and every year since there have been changes and still the club has moved forward. Continue reading...

items.title: Infantino’s opponents developing new framework for running world football
items.summary: Uefa, Concacaf and AFC working together on system Fifa has ignored calls for an independent review Gianni Infantino’s opponents are working together to produce a new framework for running world football to replace what they regard as a system of patronage that Fifa has adopted since he replaced Sepp Blatter as president 10 years ago. Repeated calls from Uefa, Concacaf and the Asian Football Confederation for an independent review of Fifa’s governance have been ignored by Infantino since his plan to sell off 21% of the World Cup was made public a fortnight ago, and the rebels are now understood to have taken matters into their own hands. Continue reading...

items.title: Djed Spence nears Tottenham exit with Inter in talks over £25.6m move
items.summary: England defender keen on move to Italian champions Udogie and Porro set to be Spurs’ first-choice full-backs Tottenham are prepared to allow Djed Spence to join Inter, with the England defender expected to cost around €30m (£25.6m). Spence – who started four games at the World Cup, including the semi-final against Argentina – has fallen further down the pecking order at Spurs after the arrival of Andy Robertson from Liverpool. He signed a new four‑year contract in north London at the start of last season but is believed to be keen on joining the Italian champions, with Destiny Udogie and Pedro Porro expected to be Roberto De Zerbi’s preferred full‑backs this season.
